task_description: Build a greenfield full-stack 'digital monster' (Tamagotchi/Digimon-style) web app monorepo: Vite React+TS frontend with 4 per-stage image assets, API Gateway + Lambda (TS) backend, DynamoDB persistence (no auth, clientId in localStorage), Amazon Bedrock conversation selecting Haiku/Sonnet/Opus by growth stage (幼年期 has NO conversation), and AWS CDK (TS) one-command deploy. Deliver fully committed code + CDK + image assets + deploy README. Do NOT run cdk deploy from this sandbox (npm registry blocked, AWS creds live only in a new Kiro Web session). Repo name: digital-monster.

verification.summary: Network mode INTEGRATIONS_ONLY blocks the npm registry (HTTP 403), so `npm install`, build (vite/tsc/cdk synth), and vitest CANNOT run in-sandbox; documented in README and feature findings. Static verification passed: all 11 package.json/tsconfig/cdk.json files parse as valid JSON; `tsc --noEmit` on the dependency-free shared package exits 0; the four stage SVG assets exist, are well-formed, and are distinct. Test quality reviewed manually: chat.test.ts mocks the AWS SDK and asserts the Bedrock command is NEVER constructed/sent for BABY (幼年期) while invoked with the stage-correct model id (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus) otherwise — it would fail if the baby short-circuit or per-stage selection were reverted. The infra Bedrock IAM policy and the runtime chat path both source model ids from @digital-monster/shared, so they cannot drift. No project Dockerfile. Full build/test/deploy run in a networked, AWS-credentialed Kiro Web session per the user's plan.
